Prices appear without a $ sign except the combination, vegetarian and kids prices, and are recorded as shown. Throughout the menu, cheese sauce instead of salsa costs $1.99 extra. The red asterisks mark the raw/undercooked consumer advisory, not dietary information, so they were not turned into tags. Vegetarian tags come from the 'Vegetarian' section heading. The site also has a separate Specials page (https://www.elrodeo123dm.com/specials/) that was not extracted.
